title: Read aloud, edited
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wood reads page one aloud to the dog. He edits as he reads: skip, skip, that stays. The dog's ear goes down at 'that stays.' The strip gives the dog the last word by giving him no word.

panels.composition: The bedroom. WOOD on the floor, back to the bed, the page. BARNABY facing him, listening because he's there.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on a bedroom floor against a bed reading from a sheet of paper to a small dog facing him, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood reading. The balloon: blocks, then 'skip', then blocks, then 'skip'.

image.prompt: a young man reading aloud from a page, his words rendered as blocks, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dog's ear going down at 'that stays.'

image.prompt: close on a small dog with one folded ear drooping lower, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood looking at the dog. The dog looking at Wood. The page lowered. Wood crossing something out. The dog's ear back up.

image.prompt: a young man crossing out a line on a page while a small dog's ear rises again, black and white, no words

notes: The dog edits by ear. 'That stays' doesn't.
